pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
Oh-oh-oh-oh… Yeah…
Should I get up again?
SKYHIGH… Let the heavens shake.
[Verse 1]
Tonight is my night, No fear, just living
Even my broken heart comes alive again, keep it breathing
My heart is beating like a dream
Even in the darkness, a little light shines through
I can't hold back my smile, I don't know why, but I don't care
It's okay if I fall, I know how to walk again
[Pre-Chorus]
Rise up, slowly, but keep on rising
Burn away my weary days, open up my sky again
Say SKYHIGH…(HA)ram! SKYFLY…(HA)jun!
Hope is lifting us higher…
[Drop]
SKYHIGH...(HA)ram! SKYFLY...(HA)jun! Run toward your dreams!
Leave your fears behind and fly!
Open your heart a little wider (Fly!)
SKYHIGH! SKYFLY! Right here, right now, SHINE UP!
Let's move toward a brand-new day!
[Verse 2]
Even when the world pushes me away, I come back again
Flowers bloom right where I once fell
Light in the darkness falls gently onto my shoulders
It settles over my scars and whispers, “You're gonna be okay”
Believe in me, everything will get brighter
Even if I'm a little late, a path will open
The higher I rise, the clearer everything becomes
Even the shadows that once held me back disappear
[Bridge]
My heartbeat is rising, but my heart grows stronger
Every moment I fell brought me all the way here
This stage isn't a battlefield, it's the threshold of a new beginning
Reach out your hand, your dream is coming closer
One step, two step! Yeah, even if we take it slow
Hope seeps in and grows inside of me
Even if this night is long, I'll follow the light
Breaking through the darkness, I'll walk above the sky
[Build-up]
Quiet… Shh… Gather your hearts…
One, two! It's time to start again
LOUDER! LOUDER! Wake me up!
[Final Drop]
SKYHIGH...(HA)ram!! SKYFLY...(HA)jun!! Rise even higher!
Light explodes, spreading across the world, HOPE IS LOUDER!
Fly!! Fly!! Fly all the way!
Let's grab the stars and fly even farther!
SKYHIGH...(HA)ram!! SKYFLY...(HA)jun!! Don't ever stop!
Believe, you will rise!
[Breakdown]
Shh… Rest for just a moment…
And then… fly again.
[Ultimate Drop]
SKYHIGH...(HA)ram!!! SKYFLY...(HA)jun!!!
Fly! Fly! With wings that awaken the dawn!
Explode! Explode! With courage burning in our hearts!
We can go all the way to the edge of the universe, there is always a way
It's okay to fall, just get back up again
Forever SKYHIGH! Endless SKYFLY!
We never come down! Hope is all around!
[Outro]
SKYHIGH…(HA)ram
SKYFLY…(HA)jun
We rise… Forever.
pkg.sunoStyle:
Trendy pop with a soft, energetic groove. Modern, fresh and emotional.
Male-female duet vocals throughout. Alternating lines, natural vocal interplay, gentle harmonies, clear and expressive vocals. Keep both voices distinct and balanced.
Light and simple intro with soft harmony. Verses begin gently with light rhythm, subtle percussion and restrained bass. Pre-chorus gradually builds emotional tension through delicate textures and rhythmic movement, without sudden intensity.
Chorus adds warmth and energy with warm bass, gentle harmonies and a smooth rhythmic lift. Emotional and engaging, but controlled and never explosive.
Final section gradually reduces energy, returning to soft duet vocals and minimal accompaniment, ending calm and reflective.
Natural dynamics, warm tone, clean modern production. Avoid loud mastering, heavy bass, excessive drums, dense layers and aggressive instrumentation.
